adjudication.rationale: The new route `get 'embed/best' => 'embed#best'` has no format constraint, so `/embed/best.json` will route to `EmbedController#best`, which only has HTML views (`app/views/embed/best.html.erb`, `loading.html.erb`) and no `respond_to`. In Rails this commonly results in a MissingTemplate/406 for JSON requests. The lack of a named route helper is true but not itself a functional defect here since `embed.js` hardcodes the path.
